finding: Possible conditional test logic: the no-offset ISO test branches on the fixture, and on a platform without time.tzset (Windows) the else branch runs the machine-local oracle.
why: The else branch cannot tell local time from UTC on a machine whose zone is UTC, so the weakness that the previous round fixed remains on every tzset-less platform, and one test body holds two behaviours.
fix: Split into a POSIX test that uses plus_seven and skips when time.tzset is absent, and keep the mktime oracle as its own separate test.
evidence:
+    if plus_seven:
+        assert found == datetime(2026, 10, 2, 3, 15, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    else:
+        local = time.mktime((2026, 10, 2, 10, 15, 0, 0, 0, -1))
